The intelligent platform for travel and spend

Trusted by 1,000s of global teams

Real work. Real Business. Real impact.

The endless booking and rebooking, the uploading receipts, the chasing, checking, reconciling. We call this shadow work. Every company has it, it’s the work behind the work, slowing people down and costing companies more than they realise.

Perk’s AI powered platform brings travel bookings, events, expense management, and invoice payments together in one intelligent platform, so your teams can get back to real work.

Tab 2
Tab 3

Wave goodbye to the work behind the work

From booking to reconciliation, Perk keeps everything moving—no chasing, no checking, no wasted time.

Seamlessly book and manage trips

Forget multiple tabs. You can book every part of a work trip and see all the details in one helpful itinerary. With our extensive global inventory, Perk gives you access to 1000s of options and proprietary rates across flights, stays, trains and cars.

Make trip changes in seconds

Plans change and so can your trips. Rebook or cancel flights and hotels in just a few taps. No need to contact customer support or even open your laptop. 

Submit and approve expenses automatically

Free yourself from piles of receipts. Powered by AI, Perk automatically captures and categorizes expenses, spots discrepancies, and flags policy breaches for you.

Automate receipt matching

No more chasing receipts. With Perk, teams can snap and submit photos of their expenses while on the go. Our AI automatically matches transactions, identifies costs, and extracts data for quick and easy processing.

Intelligent invoice management

Perk uses AI to match, code, and route invoices for approval—ensuring accuracy, visibility, and zero manual effort.

Plan and manage events

You set the budget. Your teams book their own tickets. With Perk, you can create custom landing pages that let you share event details, track RSVPs, follow up on need-to-knows, and check in post-event. All without losing sight of cost.

Your travel is flexible, your spend is controlled

With Perk, finance teams can set budgets, approve trips, and get real-time visibility into company spend – so teams can travel smarter, and finance stays in control. All in one intelligent platform.

Real-time visibility & actionable insights

See every trip, card, and invoice in one place. Get real-time visibility across travel and spend with dashboards that surface the insights that matter most—from budgets and policy compliance to booking trends and reporting.

Flexible policies and approvals

Speed up sign-offs and stay on budget with adaptable workflows. Policies are preset so approvals can be automated, keeping compliance at an average of 95%.

Role-based permissions & controls

Set custom roles and permissions for precise control across every trip, card, and invoice. Ensuring the right people can book, spend, and approve—all within one connected platform.

Built in compliance

Stay compliant without slowing anyone down. Perk automatically flags spend or bookings that breach policy, giving finance teams complete oversight in real time.

Seamless integrations

Seamlessly connect and integrate Perk with all your favorite HR, finance, security, and workplace apps for even simpler and smarter work travel and spend.

Policy-powered Perk Cards

Empower teams to spend responsibly—whether it’s on the go or for larger bookings. Issue physical, virtual, or lodge cards with built-in policy controls that automatically enforce spend limits, approvals, and compliance—and earn cashback on every transaction.

Wherever you are, we’ve got you covered

Whether it’s intelligent automation or real human help, Perk gives you the best of both worlds. From AI-powered tools that make every trip and transaction effortless, to world-class 24/7 customer care when you need a person—we make sure you’re supported every step of the way.

24/7 support

Our customer support works around the clock so you don’t have to. Local-language experts help your travellers whenever they need it, while dedicated account managers make sure your business always gets the care it deserves.

Flexible travel protection

Cancel or change any trip with ease and recover at least 80% of your spend—so your travelers stay stress-free and your business stays in control.

Live travel updates

Stay in the know as you go. No research required. Get pre-departure information on risks and regulations, and keep on top of delays and disruptions with real-time alerts.

Premium travel experience

Get our executive add-on and choose from a curated selection of hotels that go the extra mile—from flexible check-ins to free upgrades.

Group bookings and events

Perk pairs the power of AI with human expertise to make group trips as easy as traveling solo. Source venues and streamline RSVPs with our event management software or let our in-house teams take care of larger bookings.
